create.title: Discrete-curvature resonance and high-shell singleton capacity no-go
create.statement_tex: For q=4m+rho, rho in {1,3}, the exact phase F_(h,rho)(m)=sqrt(Xh(4m+rho)) has Delta F=4sqrt(Xh)/(sqrt(q+4)+sqrt(q)) and Delta^2F=-32sqrt(Xh)/[(sqrt(q+8)+sqrt(q+4))(sqrt(q+4)+sqrt(q))(sqrt(q+8)+sqrt(q))]. On hq asymp Y=R^2, |Delta^2F| asymp h^2/R, |Delta^3F| asymp h^3/R^3, and the fibre drift is O(h^2/R^2), so only the exact accumulated curvature modulo one with this tolerance is a lawful resonance parameter. On h asymp H, every nonnegative fixed-h Fejer/Weyl majorant retains diagonal capacity sqrt(RH), losing sqrt(H) against the sqrt(R) window target. For R/4<h<=R/2 each residue fibre has at most one sample. Moreover for infinitely many X=K^4, a strict top-profile window and 3K/8<=h<=7K/16 give sum_(h,rho)|T_(h,rho)| >> R with all height, profile, product and radial stars avoided. This is an actual-profile obstruction to fixed-residue or fixed-h absolute resonance averaging, not a signed lower bound for the cross-h, cross-residue sum.
create.next_action: Keep the two chi_4 residue classes and distinct h fibres signed. Test exact adjacent-odd-q pairing and unmatched endpoints on R/4<h<=R/2 before any absolute value.

update.next_action: On the top shell R/4<h<=R/2, preserve the signed pairing between q congruent to 1 and 3 mod 4 (or group by product n) and prove a short-hyperbola-strip bound of unweighted size sqrt(R). Treat lower h shells separately; do not sum fixed-h resonance majorants.
The low-h margin is closed. The next disjoint sector is the signed singleton shell R/4<h<=R/2; retain cross-residue and cross-h cancellation there.
First solve the physical signed short-hyperbola-strip core; fixed-h resonance averaging cannot supply it. Alpha connector and height transfer remain separate later obligations.

reject.reason: The exact step-four curvature must be reduced modulo one or assigned a rational approximant; its real magnitude h^2/R alone gives no discrete cancellation.
Even ideal off-diagonal cancellation leaves aggregate diagonal capacity sqrt(RH), and the high shell consists of at-most-singleton residue fibres with actual absolute capacity R.
Artificial completion endpoints are full cutoff owners. Existing angular or radial equality stars cannot be reassigned to them.

no_change.reason: The signed cross-residue, cross-h residual core and alpha transfer remain open.
This method obstruction proves no new discrepancy exponent.

round_assessment.reason: Round 56 makes the discrete modulo-one resonance interface exact and proves that any nonnegative fixed-h closure fails, including a strict actual-profile singleton-shell witness. It isolates signed cross-residue and cross-h cancellation as the next kernel but proves no residual-core bound or exponent.
